change: Compare the complete initial JSON and every serialized event in the previously reduced prefix, including payload and scope metadata. Reuse the internally produced canonical result only when those bytes match; reduce any new suffix through the same validated shared reducer.

A rewind, changed initial state or altered earlier event falls back to full replay. Malformed or failed suffixes never replace the proven prefix. Return an independent copy, and bypass retention when its byte bound is exceeded.

Only chat command replay and original-producer historical verification use this adapter. Both still read and scope-check the complete canonical event collection, including events beyond a requested historical cut. No stored head, session ID or sequence is accepted as proof of event contents.

Add an isolated native Chromium IndexedDB load path. Default CI runs 100 new-consequence actions; explicit CHAT_HISTORY_GROWTH_ACTIONS=300 or 1000 selects larger loads. At 100/300/1000 checkpoints, old facts must enter the actual actor and reviewer inputs, match full replay, and survive parent deletion, import and refresh. Fake producers and reviews are explicitly engineering injections.
